dialogue.content: おはようございます。11時からのロールプレイをよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I'm looking forward to our 11 o'clock role-play.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I'm looking forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: それでは始めます。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 初めにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 55歳　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 55-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 仕事のことできました
dialogue.English: I'm here to talk about work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 詳しくお聴かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about that?

dialogue.content: 2週間前に移動があったんですが、そこの部署が仕事が多すぎて終わりません
dialogue.English: I was transferred two weeks ago, and the workload in the new department is so overwhelming that I can never finish it.

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね
dialogue.English: That must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 差し支えない範囲で、どんなお仕事が教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind sharing, could you tell me what kind of work you do?

dialogue.content: 事務です
dialogue.English: It's administrative work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 残業とかされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you working overtime?

dialogue.content: はい、既に朝9：００から終電まで2週間連日です
dialogue.English: Yes, I've been working from 9:00 AM until the last train every day for two weeks straight.

dialogue.content: 終電まで連日・・・それはたまりませんね
dialogue.English: Until the last train every day... That must be unbearable.

dialogue.content: はいそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: お体の具合は大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling physically?

dialogue.content: はいでも疲れました
dialogue.English: I'm okay, but I'm exhausted.

dialogue.content: それは疲れますよね
dialogue.English: That would certainly be exhausting.

dialogue.content: はいそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: そんなことが、これからも続きそうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Does it seem like this situation will continue?

dialogue.content: ええ　雰囲気はそんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the feeling I get.

dialogue.content: 雰囲気というのは、みんなそれが当たり前っていう感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say 'the feeling,' do you mean that everyone acts like this is normal?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: That must be unpleasant.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 以前の部署ではいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How was it in your previous department?

dialogue.content: 以前は普通でした。残業ありましたが10時には帰れました
dialogue.English: It was normal before. I worked overtime, but I could still go home by 10 p.m.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか急に深夜までの仕事になって戸惑ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be jarring to suddenly have to work so late into the night.

dialogue.content: はいそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 部署が変わったきっかけとか思い当たることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea what led to the department change?

dialogue.content: 今の移動の部署が忙しいので、それで来ました
dialogue.English: I was transferred because my current department is very busy.

dialogue.content: 応援するための移動だったんですね
dialogue.English: So you were transferred to help support them.

dialogue.content: はい　そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 上司の方には相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you spoken to your supervisor about this?

dialogue.content: 上司も同僚もみんな同じ状況で中々言えません
dialogue.English: My supervisor and colleagues are all in the same situation, so it's hard to bring it up.

dialogue.content: みんな同じ状況だと思うと、言いづらくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: It's difficult to speak up when you feel everyone is in the same boat, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そんな中でずっと耐えてこられたんですね
dialogue.English: You’ve been enduring all this under those circumstances.

dialogue.content: 苦しかったと思います
dialogue.English: It must have been painful.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんです。耐えたと言ってもまだ数週間ですが
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Though I say I've endured, it's only been a few weeks.

dialogue.content: 深夜労働が2週間続くのはキツいと思いますよ
dialogue.English: Working late into the night for two weeks straight is really tough.

dialogue.content: ええ　本当に疲れます
dialogue.English: Yes, it's truly exhausting.

dialogue.content: とてもしんどかったと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine it has been extremely difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: この状態が続いたら、どんなことが予想されますか？
dialogue.English: If this situation continues, what do you think might happen?

dialogue.content: うーん身体壊すか、メンタルやられるかどっちかでしょうね、
dialogue.English: Hmm, I'll probably either break down physically or mentally.

dialogue.content: そうですよね私もあなたのことが心配です
dialogue.English: I can see that. I'm worried about you, too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そうならないためにはどうすればよいのかを、一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: Let's think together about what we can do to prevent that from happening.

dialogue.content: はい　是非お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd really appreciate that.

dialogue.content: まずはあなたにお聞きしますねどんなことならできそうですか？
dialogue.English: First, I'd like to ask you: what do you think you could do?

dialogue.content: どんな事と言いますと？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: いろいろな選択枝がありますよね
dialogue.English: Well, there are various options, aren't there?

dialogue.content: 仕事辞めるとかでしょうか
dialogue.English: Like quitting my job?

dialogue.content: それも1つかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That could be one option.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: 他にも、言い辛いとは思いますが、部署を変えてもらうようにお願いするという方法もあると思うのです
dialogue.English: Another option, though I know it might be difficult to bring up, is to ask to be transferred to a different department.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それも1つかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: Yes, that could be another option.

dialogue.content: 身体やメンタルを壊しそうになったら、遠慮してもいられませんよね
dialogue.English: If you're on the verge of a physical or mental breakdown, you can't afford to hold back, can you?

dialogue.content: それはそうでした‼︎教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: You're absolutely right! Thank you for pointing that out.

dialogue.content: 上司の方に相談できそうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could consult your supervisor?

dialogue.content: 今はちょっと本当に忙しいので無理そうですが、ちょっと暇になったら聞いてみます
dialogue.English: Right now, it's just too busy, so it seems impossible, but I'll try to ask when things calm down a bit.

dialogue.content: 忙し過ぎるときには、相談しづらいですよねタイミングをはかって相談されるのもいいかと思います
dialogue.English: It's hard to bring it up when things are too busy, isn't it? I think waiting for the right moment to talk would be a good idea.

dialogue.content: はい　色々とありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for everything.

dialogue.content: 今の勤め先はいつ頃から続いているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been with your current company?

dialogue.content: 5年前です
dialogue.English: Five years.

dialogue.content: そんなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたのことを職場にも理解しておいてもらった方が、お仕事を続けていきやすいですよね
dialogue.English: It would be easier for you to continue working if your workplace understood your situation, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: それはそうですよね！
dialogue.English: That's very true!

dialogue.content: 時には言いづらい事もあるかもしれませんが、仕事を続けるためには勇気をもって伝えることも大事かと思います
dialogue.English: There may be times when it's hard to speak up, but I think having the courage to communicate is important in order to continue working.

dialogue.content: はいそのとうりですね
dialogue.English: Yes, you're absolutely right.

dialogue.content: 夜遅くまでのお仕事が続いていますので、くれぐれもお身体をいたわって下さいね
dialogue.English: You're continuing to work late into the night, so please, be sure to take good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: それと、心の方も大切にしてください休日に疲れ過ぎないように注意しつつ、好きなことをやってみるとか
dialogue.English: And please take care of your mental well-being, too. On your days off, try doing things you enjoy, while being careful not to overexert yourself.

dialogue.content: ええそうします
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll do that.

dialogue.content: あなたのことを応援しています
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談しに来てくださりありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in to talk with me today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: それでは、今日の相談はここまでといたしますね
dialogue.English: Alright, we'll end our session for today.

dialogue.content: はい　失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Okay. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （相談者役お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work as the client. I appreciate it.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした‼︎)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work!)

dialogue.content: （忌憚のないコメントをお待ちしています。それではロールプレイを終了してもよろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (I welcome any frank comments you may have. Shall we end the role-play now?)

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: （終了します）
dialogue.English: (Ending session.)
